title: China Overtakes US as India's Largest Trading Partner in FY26 ($151.1 Billion)
summary: Ministry of Commerce data shows bilateral trade with China reached $151.1B in 2025-26, with India's trade deficit widening to a record $112.16B.

blocks.text: 🪝 China Overtakes US as India's Largest Trading Partner in FY26 ($151.1 Billion). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Ministry of Commerce data revealed **China replaced the United States as India's largest trading partner in FY26**, with total bilateral trade standing at $151.1 billion.
**Exports & Imports**: Exports to China rose to $19.47B (+36.66%), while imports grew 16% to $131.63B, driving trade deficit to **$112.16 billion**.
**US Trade**: Bilateral trade with US stood at $140.2B (exports $87.3B, imports $52.9B, trade surplus $34.4B).
